item.title: The Best Sunset Spots in Santa Cruz (From Someone Who Shoots Them)
item.description: Seven of the best places to watch and photograph the sunset in Santa Cruz, California — plus the timing, parking, and light notes I've learned shooting them for years.

item.title: Why Are My Photos Blurry? The 3 Real Causes (and the Fix for Each)
item.description: Almost every blurry photo comes down to one of three causes: camera shake, subject motion, or missed focus. Here's how to tell them apart and fix each one for good.

item.title: The Best Camera Settings for Golden Hour (a Simple Starting Point)
item.description: A no-nonsense starting point for golden hour: the aperture, shutter speed, ISO, white balance, and metering choices that get you a keeper, plus how to adjust as the light drops.
